posts.title: I made two more apps - Paperline and Stash
posts.description: Two more Android apps from me, and they have a few things in common. Both work offline, neither wants an account, and you pay for them once instead of every month. Paperline is a document scanner. I made it because every scanner I tried wanted a subscription or my email
